# Appendix B — Event Ledger {.unnumbered}

A dated chronology of the events the book turns on, from the discovery of gold to
the present. Each entry gives the date, the event, the actors, the place, and why
it matters structurally rather than merely narratively.

::: {.callout-warning}
The working ledger is at `_project/event-ledger.csv`: 47 events, each tagged
`[S1]`–`[S87]`. The source key those tags refer to was not preserved with the
drafts.

Until the key is reconstructed or every row is re-sourced, the ledger is a
working chronology and not a citable apparatus. Rebuilt in Phase 6.
:::

## Method

An event earns a place in this ledger if it meets one of four tests:

1. It moved a chokepoint — created one, captured one, or destroyed one.
2. It converted public money or public authority into private control.
3. It changed who could enter the elite, or how.
4. It is the date a reader would want to check.

Events that are famous but structurally inert are omitted. Events that are
obscure but load-bearing are included.

## Ledger

To be generated from `_project/event-ledger.csv` once sourcing is complete,
extended through the periods the current ledger does not reach — the Spanish and
Mexican eras before 1848, and the secession-and-route sequence of 1853 to 1862.
